task: Find all molecules mentioned in PubMed for which acute toxicity (LD50) values have been reported.
task_instantiation:
Extract acute toxicity LD50 results for substances mentioned in the passage.

Create ONE extraction record for each distinct LD50 measurement for a single substance (global_identifier) under a specific set of experimental conditions. Emit separate records when the same substance has multiple LD50s (e.g., different routes, species, sex, assay/method, formulation/grade, or different reported values).

In-scope evidence:
- The passage must explicitly report an LD50/LD₅₀/median lethal dose value (including point estimates, ranges, or values with ±, and optionally confidence limits/CI) for an acute exposure.
- Values may be in any dose unit (e.g., mg/kg, g/kg, µg/kg BW, mL/kg, mice/mg protein). Record the unit exactly as stated.
- Values taken from tables/figures are in scope if the numeric LD50 is explicitly shown.

Out of scope (do NOT create a record):
- Mentions that LD50 values exist/are collected/reviewed without stating a numeric value.
- LC50-only data (unless an LD50 value is also explicitly given).
- Chronic toxicity, NOAEL/LOAEL, TD50, EC50/IC50, “toxic dose” or “lethal dose” values that are not explicitly labeled as LD50.
- Comparative-only statements without a numeric LD50.
- Numeric values that lack a dose unit or dose basis (skip rather than guessing units).

Field filling rules:
- Put the reported LD50 string (including uncertainty/range) in `ld50_value` and the dose unit in `ld50_unit` when it can be cleanly separated; if the unit cannot be separated, keep it in `ld50_value` and set `ld50_unit` to null.
- Normalize common route abbreviations into `exposure_route` (e.g., p.o./oral/gavage -> oral; i.p./ip -> intraperitoneal; i.v./iv -> intravenous). If route is not stated, use "unspecified".
- Capture species in `species` as stated (e.g., "Sprague-Dawley rat", "deer mice (Peromyscus maniculatus)").
- Capture sex in `sex` only when explicitly stated; otherwise "unknown".
- Put assay procedure, estimation method, or secondary source/database citation in `assay_method_or_source` (e.g., iUDP, modified Karber, up-and-down procedure, Schmid procedure, ChemIDplus).
- Put confidence limits/CI in `confidence_interval` (include level such as 95% if stated).
- Put non-standard/qualifying context that materially limits generalization in `qualifying_conditions` (e.g., age group, strain, technical grade, formulation/neutralent constituent, protein basis, single-dose design); routine parameters already captured elsewhere should not go here.
- Use `extra_details` for any remaining relevant information (e.g., toxicity category labels, sample IDs, notes like “taken from another group”).

schema_spec.name: ld50_value
schema_spec.description: LD50 value exactly as reported (may include ±, range, scientific notation). Do not invent or convert units; keep the reported formatting.

schema_spec.name: ld50_unit
schema_spec.description: Dose unit for LD50 (e.g., mg/kg, g/kg, µg/kg BW, mL/kg, mice/mg protein). Null if not separable or not stated.

schema_spec.name: exposure_route
schema_spec.description: Route of administration/exposure for the LD50. Normalize common abbreviations (p.o.=oral; i.p.=intraperitoneal; i.v.=intravenous). Use "unspecified" if not stated.

schema_spec.name: species
schema_spec.description: Test organism/species (and strain if given) for which LD50 is reported (e.g., rat, mouse, Sprague-Dawley rat). Null if not stated.

schema_spec.name: sex
schema_spec.description: Sex of the test animals if stated.

schema_spec.name: assay_method_or_source
schema_spec.description: Method/design used to estimate LD50 or the cited data source (e.g., up-and-down procedure, Karber method, ChemIDplus). Null if not stated.

schema_spec.name: confidence_interval
schema_spec.description: Reported confidence limits/CI for the LD50 (include level such as 95% if stated), as text.

schema_spec.name: qualifying_conditions
schema_spec.description: Non-standard conditions that qualify the LD50 claim (e.g., age group, specific strain, technical grade, formulation, single-dose design, protein-basis dosing). Null if none stated.

schema_spec.name: extra_details
schema_spec.description: Free-form string for additional details that do not fit other top-level fields.
